cases.name: declared_source_corrected_control
cases.source_basis: The maintained corrected shared fixture is an explicit synthetic control, not native capture.

cases.name: fresh_single_command_above_ack
cases.source_basis: InputStream14-47 permits sequence2 after ACK1; existing actor controls remain sequence1 until next pop.

cases.name: acknowledged_single_command_falsely_accepted
cases.source_basis: InputStream24-38: packet count1 sequence1 with ACK1 has no staged command and MUST reject.

cases.name: queue_exceeds_max_ahead
cases.source_basis: InputStream5,24-47: queue keys remain unique in (ACK,ACK+120]; pop deletes, forget/reset clears. Queue121 is impossible.

cases.name: stream_rejected_without_rejection_call
cases.source_basis: InputStream14-47 increments rejected once for each failed accept, followed synchronously by Match1068 rejection observation. No rejection counter or call exists here.

cases.name: empty_malformed_receive_then_valid
cases.source_basis: Match1249-1264 projects an empty commands array as count0,endpoints-1/-1,actions0. RPC rejection does not print; changed valid receive does print before acceptance.

cases.name: nondictionary_malformed_receive_then_valid
cases.source_basis: Match1256 skips nondictionaries while count retains raw array size. Two nondictionary values project endpoints-1/-1 and zero actions.

cases.name: empty_packet_projects_nonempty_endpoint
cases.source_basis: Match1249-1264 initializes first/last=-1 and only changes them while visiting dictionary commands. Empty count0 cannot project sequence21.

cases.name: hidden_accept_timestamp_after_prior_row
cases.source_basis: Match1295 coalesces same action aggregates while global counters and latest advance. Hidden receive/accept occur after preceding emitted row.

cases.name: hidden_accept_latest_timestamp_regresses
cases.source_basis: Time.get_ticks_msec sampled by Match1269 is monotonic; stage calls after prior emitted row cannot acquire timestamp1 after prior wall11000.

cases.name: inserted_client_tick_freshness_control
cases.source_basis: New client_tick advances all current timing, snapshot_age and its stage counter.

cases.name: inserted_client_tick_counter_only_falsifier
cases.source_basis: Only client_tick counter is changed relative to the paired current fresh event. No stale snapshot confound.
